caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing figure atop a rectangular brown base. The figure has light brown skin and is dressed in a short, fringed skirt that is predominantly pink with red and brown patterns and vertical yellow stripes, along with a yellow shawl draped over the left shoulder and across the torso. The figure's right hand is placed on its chest, while the left arm hangs straight down. On the figure’s head is a large headdress with three prominent feather-like elements colored in shades of dark brown and gray. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects, and the overall composition is centered with the statue occupying the middle portion of the page.
title: Cigar Store Indian
